finding.headline: "The Wrapper-and-Rest Mum"
finding.problem: "My mother said tie wrapper and don't exercise or the womb won't close. But I feel weak. What am I allowed to do without harming myself?"
finding.person: Amaka, 26, village in Anambra, was told by elders to tie her belly and rest 40 days; now 3 months PP and wants to move but terrified.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Marketing angle (bridges tradition + safe science)". Verdict: PASSES.
